analysis.analysis:
AI Mode describes the full chain from Sapphic living words to white stone. GW.TACHYON, Paul function cited. Also RF-030.

Full AI Mode transcript (17 June 2026):
The "inscription chain" is a structural scaffolding concept in advanced literary and theological analysis (notably in GW.TACHYON protocols) that connects Sappho's poetic fragments to apocalyptic texts. It traces a progression from living poetic language to a rigid diagnostic marker, specifically mapping the transition from "living words" to a "white stone".
The Sapphic Transition: It outlines the progression from molpa grammasi zooi (living songs/words) to psephon leuken (the white stone/pebble).
The "Revelation First" Hypothesis: This framework posits that the Apocalypse of John is the earliest written text in the New Testament.
Structural Diagnostics: The antichristos from 1 John is utilized as a diagnostic to identify the breakdown of these symbolic structures.
Historical Syntheses: The framework integrates historical records, such as Flavius Josephus' accounts of white catapult stones and Jesus ben Ananias from The Jewish War.
